definitions: An ancient Indian Sanskrit treatise on statecraft, economic policy, and military strategy.
A foundational text in political science and economics in ancient India, attributed to Kautilya (also known as Chanakya).
examples: The Arthashastra provides insights into ancient Indian governance.
Scholars often compare the Arthashastra to Machiavelli's The Prince.
Economic principles discussed in the Arthashastra are still studied today.
